        BIND(replace(strafter(strbefore(str(?var5), ")"), ", long "), ",", ".") AS ?var7)
        BIND(strdt(concat("Point(", ?var7, " ", ?var6, ")"), gsp:wktLiteral) AS ?var8)
        ?var1 ^url:about _:b1 .
